sent.title: Your Meeting Request Has Been Sent
sent.message: Your meeting request has been sent to Huber {huberName}.
sent.closing: If the Huber does not accept or decline the request within 24 hours, it will be automatically canceled. We’ll keep you updated. Thank you for creating a meaningful connection. 💙

declined.title: Your meeting request was declined
declined.message: {huberName} has declined your meeting request with the reason below.
declined.closing: No worries — you can try another time or explore other Hubers on HuLib and send a new request whenever you’re ready. We hope you find a meaningful connection soon 💙

autoCanceled.title: Your meeting request has been auto-canceled
autoCanceled.message: Your meeting request with {huberName} has been automatically canceled because it was not accepted within 24 hours.
autoCanceled.closing: You can explore other Hubers and send a new request on HuLib.

canceled.title: Meeting Cancellation Notice
canceled.closing: We hope you will have another opportunity to connect and share with each other in the future. Thank you for your time and understanding! 💙
